decisions: g3 calls the existing insertHighlight() repository function (task 006/007) rather than adding a differently-named createHighlight() the plan doc's prose suggested; no new write path.

Slug order (analyze.json NEW-1): reading-order rank by (y, then x) among the page's existing highlights, computed from the live query at capture time -- not an insertion counter -- so re-importing the same document dedupes per spec 5.6.

Architecture correction found mid-build: a first draft placed the page+highlight composition under features/document, which would have made features/document import @feature/highlight -- forbidden by I3 (a feature may import only @feature/entities and @feature/sync from another feature). Moved the composition to features/highlight/components/highlighted-page/ (the blueprint's 'highlight' context owns 'capture, layers, promotion, import'), and gave document-viewer a `renderPage` injection prop instead of a direct import, so document and highlight never import each other. Neither context is wired into an app route yet (task 009 already left that gap; not this task's scope to close).

page-stage (task 009) extended with two backward-compatible optional props: onTextLayerRendered (hands the real z1 DOM node + size to a features-level container, since a canvas leaf cannot call a feature's own capture logic itself) and children (the z2 Stage's content slot, defaulting to an empty Layer when omitted).

Highlight fill colour: Konva doesn't inherit CSS variables (a note already in globals.css from task 005/009). highlighted-page resolves --highlight-yellow via getComputedStyle once and passes the resolved string down; no per-highlight colour semantics (individual vs shared, or per-author) are defined anywhere yet, so every task-010 highlight paints in that one default token. Flagged as a likely follow-up for 012/013.

Added vitest.setup.ts: a minimal in-repo stub of CanvasRenderingContext2D (no new dependency), because jsdom has no real 2D canvas context and even constructing a bare Konva.Rect touches one (a hit-testing colour lookup). Scoped to the 'unit' project only, and guarded for the project's Node-environment tests (sync-engine.live.test.ts), which have no HTMLCanvasElement at all. This unblocks every future Konva-leaf test (011, 012, 024), not just this task's.

Design-token guard (shared/components/tokens.test.ts) rejects raw hex under shared/components/**; test fixtures there use plain CSS colour keywords, and the real highlight colour is resolved from the design system's token in features/highlight (outside that guard's scope), never a literal hex.
